$comment: Offline advisory snapshot bundled with repo-doctor. Curated for well-known, high-impact issues; it is NOT a complete vulnerability database. Refresh with `node scripts/update-data.mjs` (maintainers only). The CLI never downloads anything.

advisories.title: Command injection in template
advisories.summary: lodash's template function allows command injection via the variable option.

advisories.title: Prototype pollution
advisories.summary: minimist is vulnerable to prototype pollution when parsing crafted arguments.

advisories.title: Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor
advisories.summary: node-fetch forwards cookies and authorization headers on redirects to a different origin.

advisories.title: Open redirect in res.location / res.redirect
advisories.summary: Malformed URLs could be used to bypass redirect validation in Express.

advisories.title: CSRF token leaked to third-party hosts
advisories.summary: axios sends the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on cross-origin requests, leaking the token.

advisories.title: Insecure default algorithm and key confusion
advisories.summary: jsonwebtoken allows an attacker-supplied secret to be used for verification in some configurations.

advisories.title: Regular expression denial of service
advisories.summary: Crafted version strings cause catastrophic backtracking in semver range parsing.

advisories.title: Server-side template injection via settings[view options]
advisories.summary: EJS allows RCE through the view options when rendering untrusted input.

advisories.title: Prototype pollution in parseQuery
advisories.summary: loader-utils is vulnerable to prototype pollution via crafted query strings.

advisories.title: Arbitrary file creation via symlink
advisories.summary: tar follows symlinks while extracting, allowing files to be written outside the target directory.

advisories.title: Authorization header leaked on cross-domain redirect
advisories.summary: follow-redirects forwards credentials to a different host on redirect.

advisories.title: Unbounded resource consumption (ReDoS)
advisories.summary: braces is vulnerable to denial of service when parsing crafted brace patterns.

advisories.title: Denial of service via malformed multipart request
advisories.summary: multer crashes on malformed multipart bodies, taking the process down.

advisories.title: Cache poisoning in the Next.js server
advisories.summary: Crafted requests can poison the response cache served to other users.

advisories.title: Proxy-Authorization header leaked to destination
advisories.summary: requests forwards the Proxy-Authorization header to the destination server when redirecting.

advisories.title: Request body not stripped on redirect
advisories.summary: urllib3 does not remove the request body when following a 303 redirect, leaking data to another host.

advisories.title: Arbitrary code execution via yaml.full_load
advisories.summary: PyYAML's full_load deserializes arbitrary Python objects, allowing remote code execution.

advisories.title: Sandbox escape via str.format
advisories.summary: Jinja2's sandbox can be escaped through str.format, leading to code execution.

advisories.title: HTTP request smuggling
advisories.summary: Aiohttp is vulnerable to request smuggling through crafted headers.

advisories.title: Segfault and potential RCE via localtime_r
advisories.summary: The time crate calls localtime_r in a way that is unsound in multi-threaded programs.

advisories.title: Buffer overflow in insert_many
advisories.summary: smallvec's insert_many could write out of bounds when inserting into a full buffer.

advisories.title: HTTP/2 rapid reset denial of service
advisories.summary: The HTTP/2 server implementation in x/net is vulnerable to the rapid reset attack.

advisories.title: Improper handling of filenames in Content-Disposition
advisories.summary: gin does not escape user-provided filenames in header values.
